scope: Linux Node 22 standalone server, dashboard SSR and six local API read routes, 50 disposable Git repositories
limitations: Each traffic run is 15 minutes rather than one hour, as permitted by the task.
The Linux fixture baseline does not reproduce the reported 2.8 GB operator footprint.
No desktop shell, operator data, provider traffic, or real accounts are represented.
RSS checkpoints use forced GC; natural traffic samples and explicit growth tolerances are retained below.

mechanic.eagerEntries: Next preloadEntriesOnStart loaded unused route modules; disable it so routes load on demand.
mechanic.backfill: Load worker adapters only when persisted transcript candidates exist.

fileTrees.ownership: Cache serialized responses; release the per-read tree graph. Sweep expired entries on insertion and evict least-recently-used entries.
